plan: ml/IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md stream P2 (fixed grid of 42 trials; pass marks B1-B3)

industry_map.created_by: file already in place, used as found

definitions.neutralisation: per signal date on that date's clean universe rows: percentile rank of the score; vol = OLS residual on the percentile rank of atr_pct (missing atr_pct -> rank 0.5); vol+size = on the ranks of atr_pct and log_turnover; vol+size+industry = score rank first demeaned within NSE industry (industries with < 5 names that date -> 'Unclassified'), then the vol+size OLS; residual re-ranked to a percentile = the new score; none = raw score

baskets.top_decile: engine rule: top max(1, round(10% x n)) by score, ticker as tie-break, equal weight
baskets.top_quintile: top max(1, round(20% x n)), equal weight
baskets.buffered_decile: tranche k inherits the names of tranche k-20 still in today's top 20%, fills to today's decile size with the best-ranked names not held, equal weight; first 20 tranches plain deciles
baskets.liq_buffered_decile: the same inside the liquid tercile (cs_rank_turnover >= 0.67), scored with the full-universe vol+size score; benchmark EW liquid tercile
baskets.H40: vol+size top decile, entry open t+1, exit open t+41 (no label pin), its own H = 40 EW universe leg as benchmark; signal dates without a t+41 session dropped

costs.flat: 10/20/40 bps per side, netted against the tranche replaced (engine)
costs.name_level: per side per name max(11 bps, 0.5 x Corwin-Schultz spread (two-day estimator with the paper's overnight adjustment, 60-session rolling median, floored at 0) + 0.1 x sigma_20d x sqrt(q / ADV20)), q = Rs 100 crore / basket size; charged on each name's traded fraction (entry vs tranche k-H, exit vs tranche k+H; costs dated at the trade's signal date); ends imputed with the steady-state median
costs.breakeven: flat per-side cost at which the mean tranche net excess vs the benchmark is zero (long-short: net L-S return zero)

definitions.annualisation: excess_ann_vs_ew / ann_return = mean tranche value x 252/H (the program's headline); IR = exposure-weighted daily active Sharpe x sqrt(252) with month-block bootstrap CI (B = 1000, seed 108); turnover_annualised = per-rebalance turnover x 252/H
definitions.dsr: ml/strategy_backtest.py dsr_block on the combined daily net (20 bps) skill series (exposure-weighted moments, T = Kish n_eff), V[SR] across all 66 books, N = 177 / 238 / 239 / 240

trial_ledger.note: N = 238 is this phase's headline (plan section 1: 177 + 61 new trials, of which these 42). Plan amendments A1 (13:00, AB0) and A2 (13:30, AB8) raised the ledger to N = 239 and N = 240; DSR is also reported at both (it moves in the third decimal). The three none|top_decile grid books are the same baskets as the frozen scorer|top_decile books; the plan counts them as trials and V[SR] uses all 66 books as instructed, duplicates included.

dsr_common.sensitivity_note: dsr_sensitivity_var_sr_of_the_24_five_year_books is NOT the pre-registered statistic: it shows how much of the deflation comes from V[SR] (which doubles once the 42 new books join the trial set) rather than from N

hold40_universe_screen.rule: a base row (already y_clean_20d) enters the 40-session universe only if its ticker's |ret_1d| stays <= 22% over sessions t+1..t+41 -- ml/data.py's y_clean_20d split/circuit screen extended to the 40-session window (prices are unadjusted; an unscreened split would book a fake loss)

cost_model_diagnostics.what: Corwin-Schultz half-spread (bps, 60-session median, floored at 0) on universe rows, by ADV20 bucket (Rs crore) and for the most traded names

B1.rule: for nested_lgbm or all51, the vol+size top decile beats the EW universe net of 20 bps, with the IR's 95% month-block CI excluding zero and IR >= 0.5 (either scorer suffices)

B2.rule: buffered decile vs plain decile, same scorer and neutralisation: turnover per rebalance cut >= 30% and the paired monthly net (20 bps) excess difference's 95% CI not entirely below zero. Scored for each of the 12 scorer x neutralisation pairs; the construction passes when every pair passes (aggregation fixed before results; per-pair verdicts below).
B2.ci_method: mean of the 45 signal-month differences, months resampled with replacement, B=1000, seed 108, identical draws for every pair; t-interval also shown

B3.rule: 40-session vol+size top decile vs the 20-session one, same scorer: annual net (20 bps) excess within 1 pp (|difference| <= 1 pp, read literally) and turnover at most half. Turnover is compared per unit of time (per-rebalance turnover x 252/H): a 40-session tranche is replaced half as often, so per-rebalance fractions are not comparable across H. The construction passes when all three scorers pass (aggregation fixed before results).

gate3.rule: top decile beats the EW universe in >= 75% of months, net 20 bps

gate5.rule: DSR >= 0.95 on the liquid book at N = 238

gate3.rule: top decile beats the EW universe in >= 75% of months, net 20 bps

gate5.rule: DSR >= 0.95 on the liquid book at N = 238
